hints.title: Shortest Path Transformation
hints.text: Moving to an empty cell costs 0 obstacles, while moving to an obstacle cell costs 1 obstacle.

hints.title: Double-Ended Queue Efficiency
hints.text: Because all edge weights are strictly 0 or 1, a 0-1 breadth traversal can find the shortest path in linear time.

hints.title: Target State Inspection
hints.text: Push 0-cost moves to the front of the queue and 1-cost moves to the back until reaching (m - 1, n - 1).

hints.title: 0-1 BFS Obstacle Path Implementation

complexity.notes: 0-1 BFS visits each cell in constant operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Dijkstra with a heap runs in O(m * n log(m * n)), which is slower than 0-1 BFS.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance matrix of size m x n stores minimum obstacles removed.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate leverages binary edge weights (0 and 1) for linear time traversal.
